# Fresh map-setup conversion. Status: 1 required, 2 verified target,
# 3 deferred title transfer (unfinished), 4 protected placeholder/holding,
# 5 missing holder, 6 unmet conversion.
# Failure markers persist: a later successful call cannot erase a failed request.
# These fields are evidence only; no production consumer depends on them.

aawc_setup_prepare_tribal_holding_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { aawc_setup_tribal_county_eligible = yes }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_tribal_status value = 1 }
		title_province = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_holding_type = tribal_holding } }
				set_holding_type = tribal_holding
			}
		}
	}
}

aawc_setup_apply_tribal_government_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { aawc_setup_tribal_county_eligible = yes holder = { is_ruler = yes } }
		save_scope_as = aawc_setup_tribal_county_capital
		holder = {
			# Title replacement may select the historical first barony instead of
			# the active county capital. Rebind only within that same county;
			# never move a multi-county ruler to another county or alter a secondary holding.
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = capital_province
					capital_province.barony = { is_capital_barony = no }
					capital_county = scope:aawc_setup_tribal_county_capital.county
				}
				set_realm_capital = scope:aawc_setup_tribal_county_capital
			}
			if = {
				# Keep the original Wanua exception; already-tribal is idempotent.
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						has_government = wanua_government
						has_government = tribal_government
					}
				}
				change_government = tribal_government
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				title_province = { has_holding_type = tribal_holding }
				holder = {
					OR = {
						has_government = tribal_government
						has_government = wanua_government
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_tribal_status value = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_tribal_status value = 6 }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_tribal_failed value = 1 }
			error_log = "AAWC SETUP GOVERNMENT FAIL tribal conversion did not reach its required target"
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { aawc_setup_tribal_county_eligible = yes }
		# Title replacement can expose the new holder before CK3 considers them
		# a ruler. Do not issue an illegal request or call this preservation success.
		# The mandatory post-lobby pass must finish this outstanding conversion.
		set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_tribal_status value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_tribal_deferred value = 1 }
	}
}

aawc_setup_convert_tribal_counties_effect = {
	# Finish ALL holding changes first. A multi-county holder's capital must
	# not depend on which of their baronies happens to be visited first.
	every_barony = { aawc_setup_prepare_tribal_holding_effect = yes }
	every_barony = { aawc_setup_apply_tribal_government_effect = yes }
}

aawc_setup_sothoryos_pirate_history_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = holder } }
		set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_pirate_status value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		# LoV assigns these historical titles to Local_Rulers_Sothoryos,
		# a ruin-trait dummy. Do not convert that shared placeholder or its laws.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				holder = { agot_is_dummy_character = yes }
				title_province = {
					OR = {
						has_holding_type = ruin_holding
						has_holding_type = wilderness_holding
						has_holding_type = unknown_holding
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_pirate_status value = 4 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_pirate_status value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { agot_dlc_check_for_landless_pirates = yes }
			holder = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_government = pirate_government } }
					change_government = pirate_government
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			holder = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_government = pirate_no_dlc_government } }
					change_government = pirate_no_dlc_government
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						agot_dlc_check_for_landless_pirates = yes
						holder = { has_government = pirate_government }
					}
					AND = {
						agot_dlc_check_for_landless_pirates = no
						holder = { has_government = pirate_no_dlc_government }
					}
				}
			}
			# AGOT's pirate elective law is a duchy-or-higher lifecycle law.
			# County-only pirates lawfully retain their ordinary realm succession;
			# attempting to attach the elective law to their county emits an engine
			# error. Apply it only to eligible held titles, matching AGOT's own
			# game-start/title-gain boundaries.
			holder = {
				if = {
					limit = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy }
					every_held_title = {
						limit = {
							tier > tier_county
							NOT = { has_title_law = pirate_succession_law }
						}
						add_title_law = pirate_succession_law
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_pirate_status value = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_pirate_status value = 6 }
			set_variable = { name = aawc_setup_pirate_failed value = 1 }
			error_log = "AAWC SETUP GOVERNMENT FAIL Sothoryos pirate conversion did not reach its required target"
		}
	}
}
